QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_31

question.text: What qualification must a compliance officer of a merchant banker hold under Regulation 28A?

answer.text: Chartered Accountant or MBA in Finance
Post-graduate degree in commerce with 5 years of experience
Qualified Company Secretary or graduate degree in law
Chartered Financial Analyst with 3 years of experience

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 28A specifies that the compliance officer must be either a qualified Company Secretary or hold a graduate degree in law. This question is scoped to that qualification requirement. The Trap: A Chartered Accountant or MBA in Finance is a common finance-services profile but is not what Regulation 28A requires for the compliance officer role; the regulation specifically points to CS or a law graduate. Note: Beyond the qualification asked here, Regulation 28A also requires two years of post-qualification experience plus specified certifications. The qualification choice in this question does not capture those additional experience and certification requirements.
